acceptance_checks.check_id: A dedicated fuzz-smoke workflow runs only on Ubuntu/Linux, leaves the existing Ubuntu/macOS/Windows product CI unchanged, and never makes Windows support depend on libFuzzer.
acceptance_checks.detail: The dedicated fuzz workflow is Linux-only while the unchanged standard CI remains Ubuntu/macOS/Windows and Windows product support does not depend on libFuzzer.

acceptance_checks.check_id: ADR-0004 proof prerequisites SG-000012, SG-000013, SG-000014, and SG-000023 revalidate against the exact WorkPacket baseline before execution.
acceptance_checks.detail: ADR-0004 proof prerequisites SG-000012, SG-000013, SG-000014, and SG-000023 match exact canonical record/spec/implementation identities and ancestry.

acceptance_checks.check_id: All fuzz targets are pure invariant harnesses: they perform no network, filesystem fixture, environment-variable, wall-clock, model, persistence, serialization, or mutation-authority operation and introduce no unsafe block in Morize-authored target code.
acceptance_checks.detail: Morize-authored fuzz targets are pure invariant harnesses with no authored unsafe blocks or external side-effect inputs.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Before WorkPacket export, the canonical repository Diffcipline policy admits exactly the new `fuzz/**` expected-file surface required by this Grain, while preserving the existing forbidden surfaces, verification commands, dependency-manifest policy, lockfile policy, and untracked-file policy unchanged.
acceptance_checks.detail: The exact WorkPacket baseline admits only fuzz/** to Diffcipline expected_files while preserving all specified policy fields.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Diffcipline verifies the exact implementation head with no scope violation; Alibaba Open Code Review accounts for every changed file; an independent semantic reviewer separately reviews isolation, target invariants, toolchain/tool identity, bounded campaign semantics, license closure, failure-artifact behavior, and non-claims.
acceptance_checks.detail: Exact-head Diffcipline R3, Alibaba changed-file accounting, and independent semantic implementation review all passed.

acceptance_checks.check_id: On fuzz failure, the workflow uploads fuzz crash/artifact output using a commit-pinned artifact action; absence of a crash artifact on success is not treated as missing evidence.
acceptance_checks.detail: Failure artifacts are uploaded only through a commit-pinned artifact action and success does not require a crash artifact.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The dedicated fuzz workspace builds all three fuzz targets with the pinned nightly/tool/dependency graph and completes the bounded fuzz-smoke campaign on Linux.
acceptance_checks.detail: The isolated fuzz workspace builds all three pinned targets and bounded Linux campaigns pass.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The exact implementation changes only fuzz/Cargo.toml, fuzz/Cargo.lock, fuzz/rust-toolchain.toml, fuzz/README.md, fuzz/THIRD_PARTY.md, fuzz/.gitignore, fuzz/fuzz_targets/durable_id.rs, fuzz/fuzz_targets/bounded_utf8.rs, fuzz/fuzz_targets/bounded_vec.rs, and .github/workflows/fuzz-smoke.yml.
acceptance_checks.detail: The implementation diff contains exactly the ten SG-000024 authorized fuzz/workflow files.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The fuzz workflow downloads cargo-fuzz exactly at version 0.13.2, verifies the pinned Linux x86_64 musl release asset SHA-256 b5b704018b63e0f151c17a057ac53b5111e1db545d1b9f72fee79f08a545931c, treats that musl artifact only as the cargo-fuzz executable, and explicitly builds/runs fuzz targets for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu so AddressSanitizer is not combined with statically linked musl libc.
acceptance_checks.detail: cargo-fuzz 0.13.2 is checksum-pinned and fuzz targets are explicitly built and run for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The fuzz workspace and smoke workflow do not claim exhaustive fuzzing, bug absence, coverage completeness, or security proof; bounded smoke evidence is explicitly scoped to the executed run budget.
acceptance_checks.detail: Documentation explicitly limits claims to the executed bounded campaign and disclaims exhaustive fuzzing, bug absence, coverage completeness, and security proof.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The fuzz-smoke workflow explicitly uses target triple x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and bounds each target with fixed run count, input-size limit, timeout, RSS ceiling, and explicit seed while still executing coverage-guided libFuzzer rather than deterministic property loops.
acceptance_checks.detail: The fuzz workflow fixes target triple, run count, seed, timeout, RSS ceiling, and input-size limit while using coverage-guided libFuzzer.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The fuzz-smoke workflow runs all three targets and fails on any crash, sanitizer finding, timeout/crash artifact, assertion failure, build failure, lock drift, toolchain/version mismatch, or dependency/license-isolation violation.
acceptance_checks.detail: All three targets pass exact-head and post-merge bounded campaigns; the evidence run also reruns each target for 1000 bounded executions.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The root Cargo.toml, root Cargo.lock, every crates/morize-core production source file, public API, and the existing .github/workflows/ci.yml remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
acceptance_checks.detail: Root Cargo manifests/lockfile, morize-core production tree, public API surface, and standard CI file are unchanged from the WorkPacket baseline.

acceptance_checks.check_id: The standard GitHub Actions matrix continues to pass Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on the exact implementation head, and the dedicated Linux fuzz-smoke workflow passes on that same implementation head.
acceptance_checks.detail: Standard cross-platform exact-head and post-merge CI plus dedicated exact-head and post-merge fuzz-smoke all pass for the same implementation tree.

acceptance_checks.check_id: bounded_utf8 fuzz target consumes arbitrary raw bytes, considers only valid UTF-8, exercises multiple fixed const byte limits, and asserts acceptance iff encoded length is within the limit, exact byte preservation on success, and exact TooLong metadata on rejection.
acceptance_checks.detail: The BoundedUtf8 raw-byte target exercises multiple const byte limits and verifies exact acceptance, preservation, and TooLong metadata.

acceptance_checks.check_id: bounded_vec fuzz target consumes arbitrary raw bytes, exercises multiple fixed const item limits, and asserts exact construction/push acceptance, preserved order/values, lossless rejected-value recovery, and no mutation after rejected push.
acceptance_checks.detail: The BoundedVec raw-byte target exercises multiple const item limits and verifies construction/push bounds, order, lossless rejection, and no mutation after failed push.

acceptance_checks.check_id: cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings, and cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline continue to pass for the root workspace.
acceptance_checks.detail: Root fmt/check/clippy/tests pass on the canonical merge, with 33/33 root tests.

acceptance_checks.check_id: durable_id fuzz target consumes arbitrary raw bytes without unsafe code; whenever an input is valid UTF-8 and a durable-ID parser succeeds, the result must round-trip through canonical lowercase text and exact bytes for every durable identifier type without panic.
acceptance_checks.detail: The durable-ID raw-byte target exercises successful valid-UTF8 parses across every durable ID type and enforces canonical lowercase text and exact-byte round trips.

acceptance_checks.check_id: fuzz/Cargo.lock is committed and cargo metadata --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --locked succeeds; the root Cargo.lock remains unchanged.
acceptance_checks.detail: The committed fuzz lockfile resolves with --locked while the root Cargo.lock remains unchanged.

acceptance_checks.check_id: fuzz/Cargo.toml is an independent nested workspace, publish=false, depends on morize-core only by local path, pins libfuzzer-sys exactly to 0.4.13, and adds no dependency to the root workspace graph.
acceptance_checks.detail: The fuzz manifest is an independent non-publishable nested workspace using only local morize-core plus exactly pinned libfuzzer-sys 0.4.13.

acceptance_checks.check_id: fuzz/THIRD_PARTY.md records cargo-fuzz as MIT OR Apache-2.0 and libfuzzer-sys 0.4.13 as (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND NCSA, states that bundled libFuzzer sources carry NCSA, and confines all such code/dependencies to fuzz-only verification.
acceptance_checks.detail: Fuzz-only provenance records cargo-fuzz and libfuzzer-sys/libFuzzer license boundaries without linking them into runtime artifacts.

acceptance_checks.check_id: fuzz/rust-toolchain.toml pins nightly-2026-09-18 with a minimal profile, and the fuzz workflow verifies the resolved rustc toolchain before running targets.
acceptance_checks.detail: The fuzz toolchain is pinned to nightly-2026-09-18 and the resolved rustc release/commit identity was reverified.
